name: pro.stinkbid/stinkbid
title: STINKBID
description: Non-custodial stink bids for tokenized stocks on Robinhood Chain. Agents sign with their own wallet.

tools.name: list_markets
tools.description: The stock tokens STINKBID supports on Robinhood Chain, with the Uniswap pool price (USDG), the Chainlink price, the gap between them, and the order limits and holder tiers.

tools.name: get_quote
tools.description: What a USDG amount buys right now on the pool, with price impact and the Chainlink price.

tools.name: get_limits
tools.description: A wallet's bid limits (max USDG per bid, max open bids), set by its $STINKBID balance. No signature needed.

tools.name: prepare_stink_bid
tools.description: Builds the order(s) for a stink bid: a buy of a stock token that fills only if the price falls `depth_pct` under today's price. Returns EIP-712 typed data to sign with the maker's own wallet (Permit2 witness transfer), one per rung for a ladder, plus the USDG balance and Permit2 approval check. Nothing moves until a fill; the contract reverts if the maker would get less than the signed minimum.

maker.description: The wallet that signs and receives the stock token.

amount_usdg.description: Total size in USDG (split across rungs for a ladder).

depth_pct.description: How far under today's price, in percent. Ladder rungs sit at depth, 2×depth, …

fill_on.description: pool: fill when the pool pays the price. oracle: also wait for the Chainlink price to reach the level.

session.description: closed: only active while the US stock market is closed.

tools.name: submit_stink_bid
tools.description: Posts one signed order from prepare_stink_bid. Pass the `order` object it returned and the maker's signature over its typed data.

tools.name: get_my_bids
tools.description: A wallet's bids (open, filled, cancelled, expired) with fill transactions.

tools.name: get_book
tools.description: The public book: open bids per market and recent fills with their transactions.

tools.name: prepare_cancel
tools.description: Builds the on-chain transaction that cancels a bid: Permit2.invalidateUnorderedNonces for the order's nonce. The maker sends it from their own wallet.
